summary: Per-agent execution config storage (exec-plane S3 slice B, cinatra#1708; epic #1705). Two ADDITIVE nullable columns on agent_templates, the PROJECT-agent authoring surface for the L1 declared environment: (1) execution_environment text — the RAW declared ExecutionEnvironmentSpec as JSON-as-text (the compiled_plan / gated_steps / lifecycle_config convention already used on this table), read through the SAME fail-closed parser packaged-agent manifests go through (parseExecutionEnvironment, @cinatra-ai/sdk-extensions) so both authoring surfaces resolve to ONE internal type and two same-recipe agents share one L1 cache entry; AgentTemplateRecord.executionEnvironment has been typed-optional since #1754 and buildSnapshotFromTemplate already captures it into the immutable version snapshot — this column is the storage that activates both. (2) execution_enabled boolean NULLABLE, three-valued ON PURPOSE — NULL inherits the instance/org posture (epic D4 default-on availability), true = explicitly on, false = explicitly opted out; a two-valued column with a DEFAULT would silently re-decide the posture for every existing row. No backfill, no rewrite, no constraint change: every existing row reads NULL on both, which is exactly the pre-slice-B meaning (no declared environment / inherit). Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries (src/lib/drizzle-store.ts), shipped in the SAME PR (core__0054 / core__0079 precedent). down() drops both columns (a declared env reverts to the pre-slice-B meaning; immutable version snapshots keep their own captured copy). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0084; a concurrent lane may claim 0085 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
